title: The landscape of cognition and behaviour in the epilepsies: from neuropsychology to lived experience
title_zh: 癫痫认知与行为的全景：从神经心理学到生活体验
abstract: Abstract Neurobehavioural research in epilepsy has evolved into a broad multidisciplinary field spanning the full human lifespan. Despite substantial progress, however, its conceptual organization remains unclear. We propose a unifying framework—a ‘landscape’—that defines the field’s structure and clarifies relationships among its major clinical and research domains. Rooted empirically in neuropsychology, but expanding to encompass the wider neurobehavioural dimensions of epilepsy, this framework adopts a lifespan perspective and organizes the field into six dimensions: (i) clinical cognitive domains; (ii) memory disorders and syndromes; (iii) complex neurocognition; (iv) mental health; (v) co-occurring lifespan disorders; and (vi) lived experience. We show that the study of cognition and behaviour in epilepsy has expanded far beyond its classical foundations into a broader, inherently interdisciplinary enterprise. This expansion has been orderly and hierarchically meaningful, progressing from core cognitive functions to increasingly complex neurobehavioural phenomena. For each dimension, we delineate central themes, principal lines of inquiry, methodological approaches, key findings and critical gaps. This framework extends beyond description and situates the field’s historical structure–function foundations within a contemporary network-based account of epilepsy and its neurobehavioural manifestations. The six dimensions are conceptualized not as discrete silos but as interrelated, and potentially hierarchically organized, systems of inquiry. Cross-cutting challenges include limited standardization of assessments, inadequate characterization of heterogeneity and latent subgroups, and insufficient attention to transdiagnostic processes that distinguish epilepsy-specific features from those shared across chronic conditions. An especially critical imbalance is evident: the emphasis on risk and impairment has well outpaced investigation of resilience and adaptation, constraining understanding of protective factors and pathways to health and well-being. By situating these six dimensions within a coherent conceptual landscape, this framework provides a foundation for integrating traditionally isolated areas of inquiry and advancing a lifespan, network-informed and transdisciplinary account of neurobehavioural phenotyping in epilepsy.
abstract_zh: 摘要：癫痫的神经行为研究已发展为覆盖人类整个生命周期的广泛多学科领域。尽管取得了显著进展，其概念组织仍不清晰。我们提出一个统一框架——“全景”，定义该领域的结构并阐明其主要临床与研究领域之间的关系。该框架以神经心理学为经验基础，扩展至癫痫更广泛的神经行为维度，采用生命周期视角，将该领域划分为六个维度：（i）临床认知领域；（ii）记忆障碍与综合征；（iii）复杂神经认知；（iv）心理健康；（v）共存的生命周期疾病；（vi）生活体验。我们展示了癫痫认知与行为研究已远超其经典基础，成为更广泛、内在跨学科的事业。此扩展呈现有序且层级化，从核心认知功能到日益复杂的神经行为现象。对于每个维度，我们阐明核心主题、主要研究方向、方法论、关键发现与关键空白。该框架不仅仅是描述，更将该领域的历史结构–功能基础置于当代基于网络的癫痫及其神经行为表现的叙述之中。六个维度被概念化为相互关联、可能层级化的研究系统，而非孤立的“孤岛”。跨领域的挑战包括评估标准化不足、对异质性与潜在亚组的表征不充分，以及对跨诊断过程的关注不足，导致难以区分癫痫特有特征与慢性疾病共享特征。尤其明显的是一个关键失衡：对风险与损害的强调远远超过对韧性与适应的研究，限制了对保护因素和健康与福祉路径的理解。通过将这六个维度置于连贯的概念全景中，该框架为整合传统上孤立的研究领域并推进生命周期、网络信息化与跨学科的癫痫神经行为表型研究提供了基础。
